content.rendered:
Brazilian Room Berkeley DJ – Tilden Park

Alternative American Wedding DJ
Ceremony DJ Wedding (Timeline for Ceremonies)

1. Background music “first day of my life” Bright eyes, “sweet disposition” The Temper Trap
2. Seating of the parents-Officiant – Groomsman March. “moths wings” by passion pit
3. Wedding Party March-Flower Girl- Ring Bearer – Maid of Honor “on top of the world” Imagine Dragons
4. Processional : Bride Walks Down the Aisle with her Father “Here
Comes the Bride” normal wedding march
5. Vows
6. Recessional Bride and Groom are Married Hitched Special Momments
that Last Forever! “home” Edward sharpe & the Magnetic Zeros
___________________________________________

Reception DJ – Music – (Timeline for Wedding Receptions)

1. Cocktail Hour “cosmic love” Florence and the machine, “amber” 311, “love away” capital cities,
2. Arrival of the Wedding Party Grand Entrance –
Announce – “best day of my life” american authors
Newlyweds Applause
Mr & Mrs Shane Jorgensen
3. Wedding Jazz Background Type – Dinner Is Served-Dinner Music-
(Games Optional)
4. Toast Best Man Maid of Honor Speech “big jet plane” Angus & julia stone
5. 1st Dance – “stolen dance” milky chance
Father/Daughter – “California Girls” the beach boys

Everybody Dances “safe and sound” Capital cities

7. Cake Cutting – “doses & mimosas” Cherub
8. Dance Music – Dancing
“ho hey” the luminers
“times like these” foo fighters
“morning view” incubus
“island in the sun” weezer
“if i ever feel better” phoenix

during anytime you can play any of the following bands/generes of these bands; imagine dragons, 21 pilots, capital cities, weezer, red hot chili peppers, milky chance, phoenix, grouplove, passion pit, the muse, MGMT, Slightly stoopid, Sublime, Alt J, Chili peppers, 2 door cinema club, Monsters & Men.

(List dancing music here)
9. Last Dance Song of the Night – Bride & Groom Thank There Guests
Departure – Goodnight Sweetheart. “you’ve got the love” florence & the Machines

DO NOT PLAY.

no cheesesy songs


East Bay Parks and Rec.
